title: SUNSTUDY retained text owner fast slice
mode: local fast implementation slice with generated controls
scope: Charge the four DXF SUNSTUDY text fields in groups 1 through 4 to retained-string ownership
Preserve replacement, copy, assignment, and reset accounting
Verify direct parser and full OBJECTS callback boundaries using generated inputs

implementation.summary: DRW_SunStudy::parseCode now routes groups 1-4 through replaceDxfRetainedStringField using four private per-field counters on the inherited table-entry lease. Explicit copy and assignment preserve those counters; reset clears them before base lease release.
implementation.layoutChange: A private four-entry retained-byte counter array was added to public DRW_SunStudy layout. Downstream consumers must rebuild; binary ABI compatibility is not claimed.

assessment.claim: The four selected parser-owned SUNSTUDY text values are charged to the shared logical retained-byte budget. Exact-peak admission succeeds; one-byte-under replacement preserves the prior final field and its charge. Copies share the lease until final reset/destruction.
assessment.coverage: Generated ASCII/Binary direct parser controls cover all four fields, exact peak, under-cap replacement, reader teardown, copy/assignment, and final release. Generated full ASCII/Binary OBJECTS controls cover actual callback suppression, ResourceLimit diagnostics, and same-facade corrected retry through a following sentinel object.
assessment.limitations: This does not bound allocation capacity or RSS, caller mutation after callback, writer/projection copies, DWG parsing, other object text fields, peer/native acceptance, or full-suite behavior.
